<!-- pr-reviewer: 0d58ccca877a78908502dee6f4cdc52b39d991bc -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Reviewer: an agent that did not write the change. Built and tested locally, merged with main (clean merge).

## What looks good
- The change affects the message and hint only. `note_stock_chamfer_gouges` (keep_law.rs) changes a `Warning::Gouge` into `Warning::StockChamferGouge` with the same `at`. It does this only for `Chamfer2D` with a stock source. It adds no warning and removes none.
- `blocks_post()` (types.rs:320) is a deny-list of three advisory kinds. The new kind is not in it, so it still blocks the post. Every cut that was refused before is still refused.
- No collision check, depth law or tolerance changed. The `contain_into` calls are the same. Only the slice of new warnings from that call is rewritten.
- The new kind is handled in the MCP finding ("gouge"), `warned_moves`, and the UI fold and location code. No other code matches `Warning::Gouge` on a path that can reach a stock Chamfer after the rewrite.
- In `kept_rejudge.rs` the refusal is still returned in the same cases. For a local (framed) path, the move number stays hidden and the cause text is kept.
- No existing golden or snapshot PNG is changed. Only the two evidence PNGs in `docs/pr-1771/` are added. No Cargo, build.rs, workflow or process file is touched.

## Results merged with main (locally)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test stock_source_holes`: 9 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Mutation: I disabled the rewrite in `note_stock_chamfer_gouges` (early return). Two pinning tests failed: `stock_source_chamfer_refusal_names_cause_and_part_as_source_workaround` and `framed_stock_chamfer_live_refusal_keeps_hint_without_local_move_number`. I then restored the code.
- The tests `a_chamfer_off_a_stock_flush_with_the_part_gouges_and_one_clear_of_it_posts` and `a_hole_kind_off_the_stock_into_the_part_gouges_and_never_posts` pass. They show the refusal still holds. The helper `gouges()` now counts both kinds.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Not run here: the full `app` quick gate, the UI suites, and the `sim` and `motion` suites. The author reports one failure that is not in this PR (`winding_align`, tracked in #1752).
- `docs/pr-1771/*.png` are evidence images in the repo tree. The maintainer may want them removed before the merge, as they are not needed after it.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` and `kept_rejudge.rs` are already over 400 lines. The PR adds a few lines to them.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
